items.title: Antonelli's drivers' title is settled; Mercedes still chasing constructors' crown
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli clinched the Drivers' Championship in Mexico. The latest official standings show 380 points for Antonelli and 261 for Verstappen; Mercedes leads Ferrari 630-504. Formula1.com's pre-weekend scenario says Mercedes seals the constructors' title if it gains three points on Ferrari in Brazil.
items.why_it_matters: Brazil's practice has not changed the standings, and the constructors' title remains undecided. These are current pre-race totals, not a result projection.

items.title: Antonelli tops FP2 as Hülkenberg is unable to run
items.summary: FIA Document 22 lists Kimi Antonelli fastest in FP2 at 1:10.763, 0.253s ahead of Lando Norris; Max Verstappen was +0.259s, George Russell +0.273s and Oscar Piastri +0.321s. Formula1.com reports Nico Hülkenberg did not run; he is absent from the FIA's 21-row timed classification. Stewards' Document 23 lists ten deleted-lap entries for nine drivers (Albon appears twice) after track-use issues at Turns 1 and 4; Race Director's Document 24 sets a below-1:13.0 interval between the Safety Car lines for qualifying and specified reconnaissance laps.
items.why_it_matters: FP2 replaces FP1 as the latest completed classification. The lap-time ruling is not itself a revised classification or a race penalty. The 1:13.0 limit applies only during/after qualifying and on reconnaissance laps while pit exit is open, not to racing laps.

sources.label: FIA: FP2 deleted lap times, Document 23

items.title: Camara receives first reprimand after impeding Leclerc in FP2
items.summary: FIA Document 25 resolves the earlier summons: the Stewards found Rafael Camara (Car 51) unnecessarily impeded Charles Leclerc (Car 16) at Turn 15 in FP2 at 16:31. They issued Camara a driving reprimand, his first of the season.
items.why_it_matters: The hearing now has an outcome. This is a reprimand, not a grid penalty, and the FP2 classification is unchanged.

items.title: FIA confirms Russell's five-place grid drop for sixth ICE
items.summary: Document 14 recorded Russell's sixth ICE against four allowed and the Technical Delegate's non-compliance finding. The Stewards' separate Document 15 now imposes a five-place drop for the next race in which he participates.
items.why_it_matters: Document 14 is the technical report; Document 15 is the sanction. Keeping them separate avoids treating the earlier report as the penalty decision.

sources.label: FIA: Russell PU change, Stewards' Document 15

items.title: Verstappen reports clutch, downshift and steering issues as Red Bull plans changes
items.summary: Hannah Schmitz says Red Bull is planning “quite a few changes” to Max Verstappen’s car before qualifying after clutch and steering problems in Friday practice. Verstappen finished third in both sessions, but ended FP2 early.
items.why_it_matters: The pace was competitive despite the problems; Saturday running will show whether the changes address them before qualifying.

sources.label: Formula1.com: Red Bull plans changes after Verstappen’s Friday issues
